sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM SY_MODEL WHERE MTYPE = #mtype# AND MJSP = #mjsp# AND MNAME= #mname#
sqlMap.select: SELECT SUBSTR(MNAME,1,LENGTH(MNAME)-5) MNAME,MCONTENT FROM SY_MODEL WHERE MTYPE = #mtype# AND MJSP = #mjsp#

SELECT SC.CODE_ID CODE_ID, (CASE WHEN #language# = 'en' then SC.CODE_EN_NAME ELSE SC.CODE_NAME END) AS CODE_NAME, HP.POST_GRADE_ID
FROM HR_POSTGRADE_POSITIONS HP,SY_CODE SC WHERE HP.POSITION_CODE=SC.CODE_ID AND SC.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY SC.ORDERNO,NLSSORT(SC.CODE_NAME,'NLS_SORT=SCHINESE_PINYIN_M')

SELECT (CASE WHEN #language# = 'en' then POST_GRADE_EN_NAME ELSE POST_GRADE_NAME END) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, POST_GRADE_ID
FROM HR_POST_GRADE WHERE ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY POST_GRADE_ID

SELECT (CASE WHEN #language# = 'en' then POST_GROUP_EN_NAME ELSE POST_GROUP_NAME END) AS POST_GROUP_NAME, POST_GROUP_ID
FROM HR_POST_GROUP WHERE ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY POST_GROUP_ID

SELECT (CASE WHEN #language# = 'en' then POST_EN_NAME ELSE POST_NAME END) AS POST_NAME, POST_ID, POST_GROUP_ID
FROM HR_POST WHERE ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY NLSSORT(POST_NAME,'NLS_SORT=SCHINESE_PINYIN_M')
SELECT A.LANGUAGE, B.CONTENT FROM SY_LANGUAGE A, SY_GLOBAL_NAME B WHERE A.LANGUAGE = B.LANGUAGE(+) AND B.NO(+) = #codeNo:VARCHAR# AND A.ACTIVITY = 1
SELECT A.CODE_NO AS codeNo FROM SY_CODE A WHERE A.DEPTH = 1 /*AND A.CODE_NO = '1439'*/ AND A.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY A.PARENT_CODE_NO,A.ORDERNO

SELECT A.CODE_NO, A.PARENT_CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE A WHERE A.ACTIVITY = 1 AND A.DEPTH = 2
ORDER BY A.ORDERNO
SELECT C.CODE_NO,C.PARENT_CODE_NO,A.LANGUAGE, B.CONTENT FROM SY_LANGUAGE A, SY_GLOBAL_NAME B, SY_CODE C WHERE A.LANGUAGE = B.LANGUAGE(+) AND B.NO = C.CODE_NO AND C.ACTIVITY = 1 AND A.ACTIVITY = 1

SELECT T.CPNY_ID, T.CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE_PARAM T WHERE T.ACTIVITY = 1
ORDER BY T.ORDERNO
select get_global_name($PARENTTABLEFIELD$,#language#) CODE_NAME,$PARENTTABLEFIELD$ CODE_NO from $TABLENAME$ where CPNY_ID=#CPNY_ID# AND ACTIVITY = 1
select get_dept_name($PARENTTABLEFIELD$,#language#) CODE_NAME,$PARENTTABLEFIELD$ CODE_NO from $TABLENAME$ where CPNY_ID=#CPNY_ID# AND ACTIVITY = 1
